content:
Latest update (October 7): Amazon has now added official countdowns to thousands of deals, counting down to midnight Cupertino time, and the much-anticipated AirPods Pro 3 discount is one of them — grab it while stock lasts.

With Amazon's fall Prime Day event underway, now is one of the best times to upgrade your AirPods. Although we haven't yet seen holiday-level pricing on Apple's latest AirPods 5 lineup, with the AirPods Pro 3 marked down this low, it may be the better value choice for most people; for those who want to experience Apple's over-ear headphones, the 2026 AirPods Max 2 is now $120 off across all five colors.

  • AirPods Pro 3 — $179 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 — $429 (originally $549)

Apple's launch of the entry-level AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation at the same $129 price as the previous generation without noise cancellation genuinely impressed me. However, if you want the wireless charging case, you'll need to step up to the upgraded $149 version — but at that point, you'd only need to spend $30 more to get the much more capable AirPods Pro, which to me is a no-brainer.

Originally $249, these are now $70 off the retail price, sitting just $10 above the lowest price we've ever recorded on Amazon — a price we've only seen once since launch.

We're almost certain to see the new AirPods 5 drop to around $100 or even lower eventually, but based on historical records and the previous generation's experience, it may not dip below $99 until 2027. And even if they do get that low, the AirPods Pro 3 still offers 3x stronger noise cancellation, longer battery life, a built-in heart rate sensor, a range of hearing aid features, and — in my view — a more secure, comfortable fit.

All of the above are solid reasons to choose the Pro 3 over the new AirPods 5 lineup; but if what you're after is Apple's premium over-ear headphones, then you'll want to look at the deals on the 2026 Max 2 during fall Prime Day.

The current price is just $30 above the lowest we've ever recorded on Amazon, with all five colors eligible for the $120 discount off the original price.

Worth noting that since this headphone launched earlier this year, this is only the second time we've recorded a price this low — historically it's only dipped below this once.

There are also deals on other top-brand headphones from the likes of Sony and Bose (you can find them below), but if you ask me, there's nothing quite like a personally tailored listening experience designed in Cupertino. If you're not entirely convinced, you can find some pretty decent alternatives below, along with a range of standout deals spanning the Apple ecosystem to choose from.
